situation: Instrument in use with an expired certificate
penalty: Fine not less than Rs 2,000 and up to Rs 10,000. Second or subsequent offence: imprisonment up to one year and also fine.
officer_next_step: Seize under section 15 if evidence is needed; issue notice; offer compounding.

situation: Instrument altered or tampered with to deceive
penalty: Fine up to Rs 50,000. Second and subsequent offence: imprisonment of not less than six months and up to one year, or fine, or both.
compounding_basis: Section 26 is omitted from section 48(1) (which only lists section 25, 27-39, and 45-47).
officer_next_step: Seize instrument and records under section 15; file complaint for court prosecution.

situation: Stamp counterfeited, removed, or moved from another instrument
penalty: Imprisonment of not less than six months and up to one year. Second or subsequent offence: imprisonment not less than six months and up to five years.
compounding_basis: Section 44 is not included in section 48(1); cannot be settled by compounding.
officer_next_step: Seize counterfeited stamp/instrument under section 15; initiate formal criminal prosecution.

situation: A Government Approved Test Centre acting outside its approval
officer_next_step: Issue show-cause notice; recommend suspension or cancellation of approval; offer compounding under section 48.

situation: An employee of a GATC wilfully stamping wrongly
penalty: Imprisonment up to one year, or fine up to Rs 10,000, or both.
officer_next_step: Conduct inquiry; seize irregular stamps/certificates under section 15; initiate proceedings or offer compounding.

situation: An officer wilfully verifying or stamping wrongly
penalty: Imprisonment up to one year, or fine up to Rs 10,000, or both.
compounding_basis: Section 43 is omitted from section 48(1); mandatory criminal prosecution.
officer_next_step: Lodge formal report with Controller/Director for departmental inquiry and prosecution.

situation: The offence committed by a company, and the question of who is proceeded against
penalty: Liable to penalties prescribed for the specific offence committed.
compounding_basis: Dependent on the underlying substantive offence (applies if underlying section is compoundable under section 48).
officer_next_step: Verify company register for nominated responsible person under section 49(2); if none, proceed against all persons in charge and the company itself.
